name: Raspberry Pi 5 board outline and header position
frame: Local mm frame as drawn: origin at the bottom-left corner of the 85 x 56 mm board, +x toward the USB and Ethernet ports, +y toward the edge with the 40-pin header

header.layout: pins 1, 3, ... 39 along the row nearer the board centre (y = 51.23), pins 2, 4, ... 40 along the edge row (y = 53.77), numbered from the end away from the USB and Ethernet ports

values.drawing: Raspberry Pi 5 mechanical drawing RP-008347-DS-1 (SHA-256 5dd680d6c1f5e7aa9c7b020695e315d04aac862df82ff01d4e9041cd0668d7f2), read visually on 2026-10-24
values.mountingHoles: Drawing: 3.5 from the left edge, 58 between left and right holes, 49 between bottom and top holes (3.5 from each edge), diameter 2.7
values.header.centerMm: Drawing: the 29 callout runs from the left mounting-hole centre to the header centre (3.5 + 29 = 32.5); the header lies on the line of the top mounting holes (56 - 3.5 = 52.5)
values.header.pin1Mm: Derived: 20 columns at 2.54 mm put the first column 9.5 x 2.54 = 24.13 mm left of the centre (32.5 - 24.13 = 8.37); rows 1.27 mm either side of the centre line. The documentation's 'Pin layout' places pin 1 at the lower-left corner of the header on classic boards, the end away from the USB and Ethernet ports, which matches the bench (the ribbon's brown conductor is on that edge)
